items.title: Global sections of a derived tensor product with a constant complex pull the constant factor out on a scheme of finite cohomological dimension
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes global sections after tensoring with a constant complex over a torsion ring on a scheme of finite cohomological dimension (statement lines 20163-20172). The proof (proof lines 20174-20190) verifies the three hypotheses of the resolution criterion: commutation with direct sums from finite cohomological dimension, the exactness condition through the triangle criterion, and the base case K = Lambda[k]. H2: one criterion applied with three short verifications.
